name: Simulates users selecting drinks
info:
MakeDrink() is called every 10secs to
simulate data flowing into the smart coffee
machine. It also increments servedCounter.

name: Maintenance Management
info:
When the servedCounter exceeds 1000, the 
maintenanceNeeded property is set to true, 
indicating that maintenance is required. 
Upon completion of maintenance, reset both 
servedCounter and maintenanceNeeded to their 
default values.

name: Top up resources when event occurs
info:
When the outOfResource event occurs, a
function will be called to top up the
resources.
